memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity and iron-deficiency anemia.
The patient reports progressive weight gain over the past year, fatigue, and occasional shortness of breath on exertion. He notes no joint pain or chest discomfort. On examination, BMI is 34.2 kg/m², waist circumference 112 cm, mild pallor of conjunctiva, and no cyanosis. Lung fields are clear, cardiac rhythm regular.
Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg with each main meal
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 6.2 mmol/L (<5.2), LDL 4.1 (<3.4), HDL 0.9 (>1.0), Triglycerides 2.2 (<1.7).
Fasting glucose 6.8 mmol/L (3.9-5.5).
HbA1c 6.2% (4.0-5.6).
Liver function: ALT 38 U/L (<40), AST 34 (<40), ALP 84 (<120), GGT 32 (<50), Bilirubin 10 (<21).
Waist circumference 112 cm.
Haemoglobin 10.8 g/dL (13.0-17.0).
Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (30-400).
MCV 78 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity and iron-deficiency anemia.
The patient feels somewhat better; fatigue less pronounced, weight stable at 92 kg. He reports mild abdominal discomfort after meals. Exam: BMI 33.8, waist 110 cm, conjunctival pallor slightly improved, lungs clear.
Smoking status: never.
